news.headline: NSE/BSE Closed Today — Gandhi Jayanti National Holiday
news.what_happened: Indian stock exchanges remain closed on October 2, 2026, for Gandhi Jayanti. No trading in equity, derivatives, or currency segments.
news.why_it_matters: Next trading session is Monday, October 5. GIFT Nifty at 22,624 (+0.59%) suggests a mild gap-up open on Monday.

news.headline: Brent Crude Holds Near $102 on US-Iran Tensions — No Progress in Talks
news.what_happened: Brent crude sustained above $102/bbl after surging 2.77% on Oct 1. Axios reported the Trump administration ordered Iran's UN delegation out of New York, with no progress on Strait of Hormuz negotiations.
news.why_it_matters: Elevated crude is a direct cost headwind for Airlines, Paints, Tyres, Chemicals, FMCG, and Logistics. Direct earnings tailwind for ONGC, OIL, and OMCs. India trade deficit widens, adding pressure on the rupee.

news.headline: Hang Seng Plunges -2.71% — China Risk-Off Intensifies
news.what_happened: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 2.71% to 23,945 on October 2 on renewed US-China trade concerns and weak domestic China consumption data. Nikkei also fell 0.92%.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asian risk-off spills into India via FII sentiment. Metals sector faces demand headwinds — China is the world's largest metals buyer. Likely to amplify FII selling in Indian markets on Monday.

news.headline: FII Sells ₹9,484 Cr on Oct 1 — 6th Consecutive Session of Net Selling
news.what_happened: FIIs net sold ₹9,484 Cr in Indian equities on October 1, extending their selling streak to 6 sessions with cumulative outflows of ₹43,687 Cr. DIIs absorbed with ₹10,042 Cr buying.
news.why_it_matters: Sustained FII selling is a major headwind for Indian large-caps. DII absorption provides a safety net but cannot prevent valuation compression indefinitely. Nifty closed at 22,421 (-0.88%) on Oct 1.

news.headline: India Manufacturing PMI 55.1 in September — 7-Month High
news.what_happened: India's Manufacturing PMI climbed to 55.1 in September 2026, up from 52.8 in August, driven by stronger new orders and production.
news.why_it_matters: Strong domestic manufacturing signals positive earnings momentum for Capital Goods and Industrial stocks. May reduce urgency for RBI rate cuts.

news.headline: GST Revenue ₹2.03 Lakh Cr in Sep 2026 — +14.7% YoY Record
news.what_happened: September GST collections hit ₹2.03 lakh crore, a 14.7% year-on-year increase. Import-linked GST accounted for a record 32.2% of gross collections.
news.why_it_matters: Signals robust consumption and economic activity. Positive for India macro, government capex capacity, and medium-term earnings of FMCG and consumer discretionary.

news.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield at 5.237% — Near 24-Year Highs
news.what_happened: US 10-year yields eased slightly from 5.293% to 5.237% on Oct 1 as stocks gained modestly. Still near highest levels since 2002.
news.why_it_matters: Very high US yields drive FII capital outflows from EMs including India. Rate-sensitive Indian sectors — Real Estate, NBFCs, Banks — face structural headwinds. Slight easing is mildly positive.

picks.catalyst: Brent crude at $102.44; US-Iran geopolitical tensions — no supply resolution in sight
picks.logic: ONGC's net realization per barrel directly tracks Brent crude. At $102 Brent vs FY27 budget assumption of ~$75-80, Q2FY27 earnings are set to significantly beat estimates. Trump admin expelled Iran's UN delegation with no Strait of Hormuz progress — geopolitical premium stays. Every $1 Brent rise adds ~400-500 Cr quarterly EBIT. DII buying PSUs adds support. Risk-reward attractive at 222 levels.

picks.catalyst: USD/INR at historic weak 96.30 per USD; Q2FY27 earnings season approaching; Nasdaq resilient
picks.logic: TCS earns ~68% of revenue in USD. At 96.30/USD vs 84-85 a year ago, FX translation adds ~14% to INR-reported revenues — a massive structural tailwind. Q2FY27 results due mid-October set up for a positive surprise. In a heavy FII-selling environment, large-cap IT with defensive export earnings attracts relative safety flows. Nasdaq held flat despite 5.237% US yields showing tech demand resilience.
